children: U.S. production of ethanol rose by 25,000 barrels a day last week to 1.118 million barrels a day, the EIA reports. It was the highest average weekly production since the week of July 24, and at the high end of estimates in a Dow Jones survey of analysts which ranged from 1.082 million b/d to 1.12 million b/d. Ethanol inventories slipped by 35,000 barrels to 25.5 million barrels. Stocks estimates ranged from 23.8 million barrels to 25.6 million barrels. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
